batch_name: Brazilian Arquivo Nacional — Ilha da Trindade UFO file (ARX.0.0.161)

events.location: Ilha da Trindade, South Atlantic (off Brazil)
events.title: UFO photographed from NE Almirante Saldanha off Ilha da Trindade
events.witnesses: Almiro Baraúna; Captain José Teobaldo Viegas; Brazilian Air Force Rot. Commander Carlos Bacellar; Lt. Homero Ribeiro; ship's dentist; several sailors; crew members in the stern and bow; at least 100 later-reported witnesses
events.source: Arquivo Nacional do Brasil · BR DFANBSB ARX.0.0.161 (Ministério da Aeronáutica, Gabinete do Ministro, 1976)
events.record_description: Brazilian National Archive file, Ministry of Aeronautics (Gabinete do Ministro). The file consists of a 1976 release of the Brazilian Navy inquiry, congressional and presidential correspondence, and the formal English-language résumé of the famous 1958 Ilha da Trindade UFO photographic case. Released to the public via Arquivo Nacional / SIAN (Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional).
events.official_location: Ilha da Trindade, South Atlantic (off Brazilian coast)

events.location: São Paulo / Rio de Janeiro / Minas Gerais / Goiás (Brazil)
events.title: A Noite Oficial dos OVNIs — 21 UFOs tracked by CINDACTA radar, 5 FAB fighters scrambled
events.witnesses: CINDACTA radar operators (flight controller Sérgio Mota); 5 FAB fighter pilots (F-5E from Santa Cruz AB, Mirage IIIE from Anápolis AB); multiple civilian witnesses across four Brazilian states. Press conference 23 May 1986 by Minister of Aeronautics Brig. Octávio Júlio Moreira Lima.
events.source: Government of Brazil (gov.br) — Official press release "Official UFO Night in Brazil", 20 May 2022. Underlying declassified FAB report dated 2 June 1986 (declassified 25 September 2009), signed by interim Air Force commander José Pessoa Cavalcanti de Albuquerque.
events.record_description: Brazilian government official press release on gov.br describing the declassified FAB report of the 19-20 May 1986 mass UFO sighting event known as "A Noite Oficial dos OVNIs". The report was declassified by the Ministry of Defence on 25 September 2009 and is the Brazilian government's most public acknowledgement of an unexplained mass radar/visual UAP incident.
events.official_location: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Goiás (Brazil)
